column3: “Will I live” is rendered “Will I recover.”
“Will I live” is rendered “Will I recover.”
The written Hebrew reads “say, You will not live,” and the reading tradition “say to him, You will live”; NASB follows the reading tradition.
“He set his face and set” is rendered “he fixed his gaze steadily on him.”
NASB supplies “evil”; “send in fire” is rendered “set on fire.”
“The dog” is rendered “who is but a dog,” and NASB supplies “that you will be.”
The Hebrew does not name who took the cover; NASB keeps “he.”
“And Jehoshaphat was king of Judah” is rendered “Jehoshaphat being then the king of Judah”; many think this phrase is a copying error.
“Daughter of Omri” is rendered “granddaughter of Omri.”
